description: Render JSX, HTML, or a node tree to PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG and animations. Rust core with JS, WASM, and native bindings.
rules: Code samples carry Fumadocs annotations such as `// [!code ++]`, `// [!code --]`, and `// [!code highlight]`. Leave them out of generated code, and read a `[!code --]` line as the API being replaced.
The `migration/v1` and `migration/v2` pages describe upgrades from older major versions, so their removed lines show APIs that no longer exist. Generate code from the other pages.
